purpose: Machine-readable catalog of every ETL block available in the Workflow page. Use this to let an LLM auto-compose pipelines (graph of nodes + edges) without reading the UI source.

node.type: string — must match an entry in `blocks[].type`
node.config: object — keyed by the `params` of the block

edge.sourceHandle: optional, only used when a node has multiple outputs
edge.targetHandle: optional — for blocks with >1 input (e.g. join), use 'left'/'right' or input index

rules: A block with hasInput=false (sources/templates) must have NO incoming edges.
A block with hasOutput=false (destinations) must have NO outgoing edges.
Edge count into a node must satisfy minInputs <= incoming <= maxInputs.
Params marked required=true must be supplied in node.config.
Column names referenced in params must exist in the upstream block's output schema.

categories.source: Data Sources — entry points; no input port
